title: Roboparty/UFO
abstract:
An open-source unsupervised RL framework for humanoid control with FB/TeCH training, robot-aware motion import, and real-world teleoperation.

UFO: A General U nsupervised Reinforcement Learning F ramework for Humanoid C O ntrol English | 中文        --> ## Overview UFO is a source-available research framework for humanoid control. The `main` branch focuses on MJLab training, robot-aware motion-data import, tracking/goal/reward inference, and ONNX export. The most complete and best-tested path is currently Unitree G1. UFO is designed to separate the learning pipeline from robot-specific configuration where practical, but new robot bring-up is still experimental. A new robot requires a MuJoCo XML, optionally a matching URDF, and motion data that has already been adapted or retargeted to that robot in RobotState format. UFO does not automatically retarget human motion or another robot's motion to a new robot, and one checkpoint cannot be directly reused across robots with different bodies, actions, or observation dimensions. ## What is supported? | Capability | Status | | --- | --- | | Unitree G1 training | Supported and best tested | | Motion data: RobotState CSV / NPZ / `ufo_pkl` | Supported | | Multi-source data manifest | Supported | | Tracking inference | Robot-config aware | | Goal inference | Robot-config aware; non-G1 requires robot-specific goal JSON | | Reward inference | G1 full default tasks; non-G1 currently limited to root/locomotion tasks | | Deployment and teleoperation | Use the [`deploy` branch](https://github.com/Roboparty/UFO/tree/deploy) / UFO-Deploy runtime | | Automatic motion retargeting | Not supported | | Cross-robot shared-policy training | Not supported | > [!NOTE] > `main` branch = training / data import / inference / ONNX export. > `deploy` branch = G1 real-robot deployment / teleoperation runtime. ## Installation Clone UFO first: Install [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/): Alternatively: Install the environment: ### Optional: W&B logging W&B logging is optional. abstract_zh: 一个开源的无监督强化学习框架，用于人形控制，支持FB/TeCH训练、机器人感知的运动导入以及真实世界遥操作。UFO：一个用于人形控制的通用无监督强化学习框架。英文 | 中文。概述：UFO是一个用于人形控制的源码可获取研究框架。`main`分支专注于MJLab训练、机器人感知的运动数据导入、跟踪/目标/奖励推理以及ONNX导出。目前最完整且测试最充分的路径是Unitree G1。UFO在设计上尽可能将学习流程与机器人特定配置分离，但新机器人的启动仍处于实验阶段。一个新机器人需要MuJoCo XML文件，可选配对的URDF，以及已经适配或重定向到该机器人的RobotState格式运动数据。UFO不会自动将人类运动或其他机器人的运动重定向到新机器人，且一个检查点不能直接在不同身体、动作或观测维度的机器人之间复用。支持的功能：Unitree G1训练（支持且测试最充分）、运动数据：RobotState CSV / NPZ / `ufo_pkl`（支持）、多源数据清单（支持）、跟踪推理（机器人配置感知）、目标推理（机器人配置感知；非G1需要机器人特定的目标JSON）、奖励推理（G1完整默认任务；非G1目前限于根/运动任务）、部署与遥操作（使用`deploy`分支 / UFO-Deploy运行时）、自动运动重定向（不支持）、跨机器人共享策略训练（不支持）。注意：`main`分支 = 训练/数据导入/推理/ONNX导出。`deploy`分支 = G1真实机器人部署/遥操作运行时。安装：首先克隆UFO：安装`uv`：或者：安装环境：可选：W&B日志记录。W&B日志记录是可选的。要启用它，请先进行身份验证，可选设置自己的实体，然后添加`--use-wandb -`。
tldr_zh: UFO是一个开源无监督强化学习框架，用于人形控制，支持Unitree G1训练与部署。
